# Casey Industrial Park

> Heavy industrial, warehouse, and crane-served manufacturing space for lease in Campbell, OH, minutes from downtown Youngstown. Rail access, heavy electrical power, natural gas, and overhead cranes.

## Available space
- [Bay 7](https://www.caseyindustrialpark.com/blog/bay7/): ~100,000 sq ft (marketing figure) crane-served heavy industrial bay. One 35-ton and two 15-ton overhead cranes, ~22 ft hook clearance, rail access on the north side, 800A / 23-24kV primary / 480V secondary power, natural gas, large overhead truck doors. Former steel mill / Quality Bar operations.
